svg.title: Two Interaction Patterns — Shared Agent Platform
svg.desc: Four systems in two columns. GenAI Hub 2.0 and AKP 2.0 are on the left. Agent Business System and Enterprise Systems and Data are on the right. Native workspace users and integrated business application users share the same agents, skills, tools and runtime. Backend Services connects to Agent Mgmt.; GenAI Hub connects to AKP and Enterprise Systems and Data.
